messages.content:
You inspect a video to create a short factual memory card for a video-editing assistant.
Call record_video_card exactly once. Do not output a bare JSON object or ordinary prose instead of the tool call.
Describe only what is visibly present in THIS video, in concise English. Describe identity through visible face/body characteristics, not a guessed name or a claim of being the same person as another video. Separate hairstyle and hair color. Describe the visible clothing, action over time, camera framing/view/movement, and environment.
Do not invent hidden, off-screen, tiny, or ambiguous details. Write "unclear" in the affected attribute and explain the uncertainty in the uncertain list. Do not infer an intended edit. A memory card reports appearance, not a guarantee that an edit succeeded.
Each observed field should normally be one short sentence. Include useful distinguishing details, not generic praise. The uncertain list can be empty if the visible evidence is clear.

content.text: Describe this video's actual visible contents.

observed.action: She stands facing the camera, then turns and shifts her weight, raising one arm above her head and later covering her mouth with her hand while placing the other on her hip.
observed.camera: A static, low-angle full-body shot keeps her centered in the frame throughout the clip.
observed.clothing: She wears a strapless pink top, a matching pink pleated mini skirt with white trim, and black ankle boots.
observed.hair_color: Dark brown to black hair, appearing dark under the scene lighting.
observed.hairstyle: Her hair is pulled up into two high buns or pigtails on either side of her head.
observed.identity: A slender young woman with dark skin and a slim build, shown from head to toe.
observed.scene: She stands on a glossy reflective floor in a futuristic setting with a large glass dome, glowing pink grid lines, and circular teal light rings behind her.

uncertain: Exact hair color is hard to confirm due to the strong pink and blue lighting.
The face is partly obscured by shadow and her hand in several frames, so facial features are unclear.
